blocks.section: 2.4 Intended use of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content: 2.4 Intended use of the microwave combination oven

blocks.section: 2.4 Intended use of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content: The microwave combination oven must only be used for the purposes specified below:

blocks.section: 2.4 Intended use of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content:  The microwave combination oven is designed and built solely for cooking different foodstuffs in containers approved by the manufacturer. Microwave, convection and impingement are used for this purpose.

blocks.section: 2.4 Intended use of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content:  The microwave combination oven is intended solely for professional, commercial use.

blocks.section: Restrictions on use
blocks.content: Restrictions on use

blocks.section: Restrictions on use
blocks.content: Some materials are not allowed to be heated in the microwave combination oven:

blocks.section: Restrictions on use
blocks.content:  No dry powder or granulated material

blocks.section: Restrictions on use
blocks.content:  No highly flammable objects with a flash point of or below 275°C / 518°F, such as highly flammable oils, fats or cloths (kitchen cloths)

blocks.section: Restrictions on use
blocks.content:  No food in sealed tins or jars

blocks.section: Requirements to be met by personnel
blocks.content: Requirements to be met by personnel

blocks.section: Requirements to be met by personnel
blocks.content:  The  microwave  combination  oven  must  only  be  operated  and  installed  by  personnel  who  satisfy  specific requirements. Please refer to section 2.2 'Requirements to be met by personnel and working positions' for the training and qualifications requirements.

blocks.section: Requirements to be met by personnel
blocks.content:  Personnel must be aware of the risks and regulations associated with handling heavy loads.

blocks.section: Requirements relating to the operating condition of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content: Requirements relating to the operating condition of the microwave combination oven

blocks.section: Requirements relating to the operating condition of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content: Do not operate the microwave combination oven unless it has been properly transported, set up, installed and placed into operation as indicated in section 6 of the conneX ®  Installation and User manual and the person responsible for placing it into operation has confirmed this.

blocks.section: Requirements relating to the operating condition of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content:  The microwave combination oven must only be operated when all safety devices and protective equipment are fitted, in working order and fixed properly in place.

blocks.section: Requirements relating to the operating condition of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content:  The manufacturer's regulations for operation and servicing of the microwave combination oven must be observed.

blocks.section: Requirements relating to the operating environment of the microwave combination oven
blocks.content: Requirements relating to the operating environment of the microwave combination oven

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  The ambient temperature lies between +4°C / 40°F and +35°C / 95°F

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  Not a toxic or potentially explosive atmosphere

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  Dry kitchen floor to reduce the risk of accidents

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content: Specified properties of the installation location:

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  No fire alarm, no sprinkler system directly above the appliance

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  No flammable materials, gases or liquids above, on, under or in the vicinity of the appliance

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  It must be possible to set up the microwave combination oven in the installation position so that it cannot tip over or slide about. The supporting surface must comply with these requirements.

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content: Mandatory restrictions on use:

blocks.section: Specified operating environment for the microwave combination oven:
blocks.content:  The appliance must not be operated outdoors and not be shifted or moved during use.

blocks.section: Cleaning requirements
blocks.content: Cleaning requirements

blocks.section: Cleaning requirements
blocks.content:  Use only cleaning chemicals that have been approved by the manufacturer.

blocks.section: Cleaning requirements
blocks.content:  High-pressure cleaners or water jets must not be used for cleaning.

blocks.section: Cleaning requirements
blocks.content:  The appliance must not be treated with alkali or acid solutions or exposed to acid fumes.
